title.es: Aquel en el que Jaime las vio
title.en: The One Where Jaime Saw Them

description.es: Jaime le dice a Marta que la vio a ella y a Fina besándose. Marta dice que quiere a Fina, pero que han terminado su relación y que quiere mantener su matrimonio, y discuten. Marta le dice a Fina que Jaime lo vio todo. Dice que le contó que no se quieren y que fue algo del momento.
description.en: Jaime tells Marta that he saw her and Fina kissing. Marta says that she loves Fina but that they have ended their relationship and that she wants to keep her marriage going, and they argue. Marta tells Fina that Jaime saw everything. She says she told him that they do not love each other and that it was a momentary thing.
